_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values before running bot.py
_dry_run_comment: Set dry_run to true for your first run. The bot will paste and verify replies but will NOT click Save. Set to false only after reviewing the dry-run log.
_verbose_logging_comment: When true, paste-verification failures log the full expected/actual text to the log file. Keep false for production to avoid storing sensitive reply content in the log.
_selectors_comment: Fill these after inspecting the real portal HTML. See README for guidance.
